decision_conditions: The proposed development, by virtue of its overall size, scale, mass and design, would result in disproportionate and unsympathetic additions to the property which would fail to appropriately integrate with the existing dwelling or surrounding street scene. The resultant structure would dominate and unbalance the dwelling to a significant extent, as well as the building to which it is a part, and create a top-heavy, overly-enlarged appearance to an otherwise modestly proportioned dwelling. The proposal represents an overdevelopment of the site in which the proposed additions are neither subservient nor proportionate to the modest scale of the existing property and surrounding dwellings in the close. The proposal would appear as incongruous when viewed in the context of the surrounding street scene and harmfully detract from the character and appearance of the area. The  proposed development, by virtue of its layout and design, would fail to provide a reasonable level of outlook for two habitable rooms on the first floor (labelled Bedroom 1 and study). As such, the proposed development would provide a sub-standard and unsatisfactory level of internal living accommodation for future occupiers, contrary to Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021).
description: Erection of two storey rear, side and front extension, 3 x roof lights, amendments to fenestration, following demolition of existing side garage.
